answers.core:
Yes. This feature must be implemented in the core engine because safe await support in worker threads requires changes at the GDScript interpreter and scheduler level.
An add-on in the asset library cannot modify the internal coroutine handling or thread execution model of the engine.

Without core support, any attempt to simulate this behavior in an add-on would still rely on workarounds like polling or manual signaling, which do not provide the same safety guarantees, syntax integration, or performance benefits as a native implementation.
answers.workaround:
No, it cannot be fully worked around with just a few lines of script.
While it is possible to simulate delays or main-thread communication in worker threads using Mutex, Semaphore, or manual polling, these approaches cannot replicate the simplicity and clarity of a direct await expression in a thread context.

For example, if I want to write:

title: Allow await to be safely used across threads (Because it's really not safe.)
